_about: The single declaration authority for the kernel's node types, props, style rows, enum vocabularies, and opcodes. build.rs generates the Rust types, the wire codec, the style mask, and the schema digest from this file. Nothing here is hand-mirrored anywhere else; a second copy of any table is a defect.

nodeTypes.name: Control
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1069.001 D2: a form control (`input type=checkbox`, with `switch`), a measured leaf whose size the host reports; its `type` prop says which widget it is.

nodeTypes.name: Video
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1042: HTML's `video`, and its `audio` (`semanticTag` audio, LLP 1042 §8): one media node, one player per host.

nodeTypes.name: Head
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1048.003 D1: the document's metadata, never laid out or painted; hosts write it into the page's head, window or scene title.

nodeTypes.name: SvgGroup
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055 D1/D3: an SVG 2 element inside an `svg`; its subtree is outside box layout.

nodeTypes.name: SvgViewport
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D4: an `svg` inside an `svg`, a new SVG viewport; never a box.

nodeTypes.name: SvgDefs
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D3/D7/D8: SVG 2 `defs`, gradients, `stop`, `use` and `symbol`; referenced by id, never painted where they stand (a gradient or symbol).

nodeTypes.name: SvgClipPath
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D10: SVG 2 `clipPath`, referenced by `clip-path: url(#…)`, never painted.

nodeTypes.name: SvgText
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D11: SVG 2 `text` and `tspan`: runs shaped by the host, placed by the kernel's positioning.

nodeTypes.name: SvgMarker
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D9: SVG 2 `marker`, drawn at the vertices of the shapes whose marker-start/mid/end name it, never where it stands.

nodeTypes.name: SvgMask
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D10: SVG 2 `mask`, rendered only through a `mask: url(#id)` reference, as an island on native hosts.

nodeTypes.name: SvgPattern
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D7: SVG 2 `pattern`, a paint server whose tile is its content, drawn only where a fill or stroke names it.

nodeTypes.name: SvgForeignObject
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D13, §8 ruling 5: SVG 2 `foreignObject`, real HTML inside an `svg` on the web; native hosts refuse it by name and draw nothing.

nodeTypes.name: SvgFilter
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D14: SVG 2 `filter`, applied only through a `filter: url(#id)` reference.

nodeTypes.name: SvgFe
nodeTypes._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D14: a filter primitive or one of its children (feMergeNode, feFuncR/G/B/A, the lights); its tag is the `fe` prop.

_propKinds: str | bool | int (i64) | float (f64). `measure: true` marks props whose change invalidates a text leaf's intrinsic size.

props.name: accessibilityModal
props._comment: @ref LLP 1080.003: ARIA `aria-modal`: while true, assistive technology reaches only this element's subtree among its siblings (iOS `accessibilityViewIsModal` while exposed; the web's `aria-modal`, which ARIA honours on a `dialog` or `alertdialog` role; macOS deferred).

props.name: dataset
props._comment: @ref LLP 1075.003 §3.3: a node's data-* words as one JSON object of strings, keys sorted (the NativeProps opcode); data-<word> attributes on the web, read by a native hook.

props.name: navigationScroll
props._comment: @ref LLP 1075.003 §3.5: the HTML id of the route's content scroll view, resolved inside the route as its Back control is.

props.name: accessibilityControls
props._comment: @ref LLP 1075.003 §3.7: aria-controls, the HTML id of the element a control controls; a tab names its tabpanel.

props.name: hook
props._comment: @ref LLP 1075.003.000: the word naming a node the app's native code receives (its view and platform object); a hooked node leaves the host's fast path. data-hook on the web.

props.name: scrollStart
props._comment: @ref LLP 1010 §6.5: `scroll-start` on a virtualized list, `start` (the default) or `end` — where it opens.

props.name: accessibilityPressed
props._comment: ARIA `aria-pressed` on a button: a toggle button's state, `true`, `false` or `mixed`; absent (or any other word), the button is no toggle. A bool expression is written as `true`/`false`.

props.name: viewBox
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055 D1/D2: SVG 2 attributes CSS cannot set are props; the properties it can are style rows.

props.name: x1
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D4: SVG length attributes CSS cannot set: the authored text (a number, a unit, or a percentage of the viewport), parsed by kernel/src/svg/length.rs.

props.name: bitmapWidth
props._comment: @ref LLP 1056 D6 (r3): a canvas's explicit bitmap width, the web canvas `width` attribute; the bitmap is stretched to the content box.

props.name: fx
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D7: paint-server attributes CSS cannot set, as their authored text.

props.name: textX
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D11: SVG text's positioning attributes x, y, dx, dy, as authored (lists; one value in stage 5).

props.name: markerWidth
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D9: a marker's viewport, reference point, orientation and units, as authored.

props.name: maskUnits
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D7, D10: a mask's and a pattern's units and a pattern's transform, as authored.

props.name: fe
props._comment: @ref LLP 1055.000 D14: a filter primitive's tag (`fe`), and its attributes as authored; `dx`, `dy`, `scale`, `x`, `y`, `z` lower to the fe*/light* names where a row or another prop has the plain name.

props.name: accept
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.002 D1: HTML's `accept` on `input type=file`, the MIME list as HTML writes it; the bake bounds it to image/video types and the manifest's `file_handlers`.

props.name: multiple
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.002 D1: HTML's `multiple` on `input type=file`: the picker may return more than one file.

props.name: min
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.001 D1: HTML's `min` on `input type=range` (a number) and the date types (an ISO value), as HTML writes it.

props.name: max
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.001 D1: HTML's `max`, as `min`.

props.name: step
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.001 D1: HTML's `step` on `input type=range` (a number, or `any`).

props.name: glassGroup
props._comment: @ref LLP 1053.000.000 D1: the element's subtree is one Liquid Glass group whose glass begins to merge this many points apart (UIGlassContainerEffect, NSGlassEffectContainerView). Layout-neutral; drawn only on Apple 26+.

props.name: buttonStyle
props._comment: @ref LLP 1069.011 D2: a native button's style, a name in `buttonStyles`; absent, `bordered`. Only on a `button` whose appearance is `auto`.

props.name: symbolEffectValue
props._comment: @ref LLP 1077 D12: a symbol's discrete effect (bounce, wiggle) plays each time this value changes, as SwiftUI's `.symbolEffect(_:value:)`.

props.name: listStyle
props._comment: @ref LLP 1084 D2: a grouped list's style, `inset-grouped`, `grouped` or `plain`; set by Contract on every `list` whose appearance is `auto` (UICollectionLayoutListConfiguration.Appearance on iOS).

props.name: sharedElement
props._comment: @ref LLP 1013.000 D1: the node's shared-element name. A name that leaves one node and arrives at another in one commit is a handoff (CommitReceipt::handoffs); the arriver flies from the leaver's box.

props.name: rows
props._comment: HTML textarea preferred line count; absent or invalid, two. CSS height and field-sizing override intrinsic size.

props.name: maxlength
props._comment: HTML maximum user-entered UTF-16 length; absent or negative, unlimited. Programmatic value changes are not truncated.

props.name: target
props._comment: HTML's link `target`, `_blank` or `_self`: where the web opens a link's URL. Unset, a link to an absolute URL opens in a new browsing context, as the native hosts open it in the system browser (x2apps chat F11, hn-reader F3); natively a path navigates in the app and any other URL leaves it, whatever the target.

props.name: enterKeyHint
props._comment: HTML's `enterkeyhint` (feed F25): what a software keyboard's enter key says — enter, done, go, next, previous, search or send. The web writes the attribute; iOS sets the field's return key; a host with no software keyboard (macOS, Linux, a desktop browser) has nothing to label.

props.name: accessibilityInvalid
props._comment: ARIA `aria-invalid` (x2apps onboarding F22): `true`, `false`, `grammar` or `spelling`; a bool expression is written as `true`/`false`. AppKit serves WebKit's `AXInvalid`; UIKit has no such property, so iOS exposes none.

props.name: accessibilityDescribedBy
props._comment: ARIA `aria-describedby`: the HTML ids, space-separated, of the elements whose text describes this one (accname's description), after `aria-description`'s words. AppKit's `AXHelp`, UIKit's `accessibilityHint`.

props.name: accessibilityRequired
props._comment: ARIA `aria-required` (x2apps onboarding F22): a field the form needs filled. AppKit's `AXRequired`; UIKit has no such property, so iOS exposes none.

props.name: accessibilityHasPopup
props._comment: ARIA `aria-haspopup` (x2apps spreadsheet F20): `false`, `true`, `menu`, `listbox`, `tree`, `grid` or `dialog`; a bool expression is written as `true`/`false`. AppKit serves Chromium's `AXHasPopup` and `AXPopupValue`; UIKit has no such property, so iOS exposes none.

props.name: accessibilityLabelledBy
props._comment: ARIA `aria-labelledby` (x2apps ledger2 Rough 3): the HTML ids, space-separated, of the elements whose text names this one; accname takes it before `aria-label`. AppKit's `AXTitle`/`accessibilityLabel`, UIKit's `accessibilityLabel`.

_enums: Wire discriminant is the 0-based index. An unknown discriminant is a typed decode rejection, never a fallback.

TextAlign._comment: @ref LLP 1053: CSS's initial value is `start`; `start` and `end` follow the paragraph's `direction` (Paragraph::from_style resolves them to left or right).

WhiteSpace._comment: @ref LLP 1053 §0 G5: the shorthand of white-space-collapse × text-wrap-mode (normal = collapse wrap, pre-wrap = preserve wrap, nowrap = collapse nowrap, pre-line = preserve-breaks wrap, pre = preserve nowrap).

FontVariantNumeric._comment: @ref LLP 1053 §0 G4: the keywords of the font_variant_numeric row, not a wire enum. normal is 0; tabular-nums is bit 0 (1), the OpenType tnum feature of the chosen face. Other CSS values are refused by name.

StrokeLinejoin._comment: @ref LLP 1055 D2: SVG 2 stroke-linejoin; arcs and miter-clip are refused.

TextTransform._comment: @ref LLP 1064 D5: applied once, where the kernel produces a paragraph's runs; editable text is never transformed.

Hyphens._comment: CSS `hyphens` (Text 3 §5.4, the reader diary). manual: a soft hyphen (U+00AD) is a break that shows a hyphen; none: it is not a break, so the kernel's runs carry U+034F in its place (as invisible, the same length in UTF-8 and UTF-16, no break opportunity); auto: also the hyphenation points of the document's language, where the host has a dictionary (the web, Apple; Linux has none and declares it, LLP 1001).

_styles: Each row is one mask bit. codec: dimension (u8 kind + f32; kind 0 auto, 1 points, 2 percent as authored 0-100 points, 3-6 an env(safe-area-inset-top/right/bottom/left) length with the f32 the points added, 7 calc(<percent> ± <px>) with a second f32 the points, 8-13 an env(viewport-segment-width/height/top/left/bottom/right x y) length with the f32 the points added and then two u8 indices x then y — LLP 1078 D3; 14-23 viewport vw/vh/vmin/vmax/svw/svh/lvw/lvh/dvw/dvh with f32 the percentage) | f32 | u8 | u16 | u32 | i32 | rgba8 | vec2 (f32 f32) | auto-color (u8: 0 auto, 1 followed by color) | color2 (rgba8 rgba8) | tracks (CSS grid-template grammar Taffy can lay out: none, named lines, px, %, fr, auto, min/max-content, fit-content(), minmax(), and fixed/auto-fill/auto-fit repeat(); canonical CSS text on the wire) | placement (CSS grid placement: auto, nonzero numeric or named lines and positive numeric or named spans; canonical CSS text on the wire) | aspect-ratio (CSS text: auto, a ratio, or both) | background-image (CSS text: none or one gradient, LLP 1066) | paint (CSS text: none, currentcolor, or a colour) | dasharray (CSS text: none or a list of numbers) | transform (CSS text: a transform list) | paint-order (CSS text: normal, or fill/stroke/markers) | marker (CSS text: none or url(#id)) | transform-origin (CSS text: one to three lengths, percentages or keywords) | animations (`_animations`) | drag-timeline, animation-timeline, animation-range, timeline-scope (CSS text: the four timeline rows, LLP 1057.003) | enum:<Name>. admitsAuto applies to dimension rows only; Auto on a non-admitting row is a typed decode rejection. Every length row (each dimension, line-height, font-size, letter-spacing, the gaps, border widths and radii, shape-margin) also takes CSS `rem` and `em` through `set_dynamic`; the row holds the pixels the kernel resolves at the end of each commit against the host's root font size (LLP 1069.000 D3), so every reader and the wire see pixels. layout: a change re-runs layout. text: a change invalidates text measurement. inherited: the row follows CSS inheritance — a node without its own row takes the nearest logical ancestor's computed value, else the initial value (LLP 1035.000 D1); the kernel marks the descendants an inherited change reaches. Defaults are the storage defaults AND the semantic defaults — this table is the one default authority, and the defaults are CSS's: a bare node is a block, content-box, flex-direction row, flex-shrink 1 (rules/RULES.md: the web is the standard).

styles._comment: @ref LLP 1053 G1: CSS `auto || <ratio>`, kept as authored (the auto flag and both numbers).

@ref LLP 1077 D4: CSS `box-shadow`, `none` or a list (at most 8) of shadows, each `inset? <length>{2,4} <color>` in any order, painted as CSS paints outer and inset shadows; it replaced LLP 1064's four shadow rows. A missing colour is refused (LLP 1064 D1).
@ref LLP 1043.000 §3 D1: only absolute + both excludes. Ignored on non-absolute nodes; other wire values behave as auto.
CSS `scroll-behavior`: `smooth` animates a scrollTop/scrollLeft prop write on every host; a user's own scroll is never affected.
@ref LLP 1055 D2: SVG 2 presentation properties as CSS rows, inherited as SVG says. paint: none | currentcolor | <color>.
SVG 2 geometry properties (LLP 1055.000 D4): lengths in user units or percentages of the nearest viewport.
@ref LLP 1055 D5: CSS `animation`, each entry with its resolved @keyframes (grammar: `_animations`).
@ref LLP 1055.000 D4: SVG 2 geometry properties x, y, rx, ry as CSS rows.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D5: CSS `transform` on SVG elements; SVG's attribute grammar is its presentation attribute.
CSS `transform-origin`; an SVG element without the row takes the UA's `0 0`.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D5: SVG 2 `vector-effect`: none | non-scaling-stroke.
CSS `visibility`, honoured by SVG elements (LLP 1055.000 D19).
@ref LLP 1055.000 D7: SVG 2 stop-color (a colour or currentcolor; `none` is refused) and stop-opacity, not inherited.
SVG 2 paint-order: normal, or fill/stroke/markers in an order.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D10: SVG 2 clip-rule.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D11: SVG 2 text-anchor and dominant-baseline, inherited.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D17: SVG 2 pointer-events on SVG elements (auto is visiblePainted).
@ref LLP 1055.000 D9: SVG 2 marker-start, marker-mid and marker-end: none or url(#id), inherited.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D10: CSS `mask` on SVG elements: none or url(#id) naming a `mask` (the CSS property is `mask`; `mask` is the row mask's own name here).
@ref LLP 1055.000 D10: CSS Masking `mask-type` on a `mask` element.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D14: CSS `filter` on SVG elements: none, url(#id) and the filter functions, in order.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D14: flood-color and flood-opacity (feFlood, feDropShadow), lighting-color, not inherited; color-interpolation-filters, inherited.
@ref LLP 1055.000 D19, §8 ruling 6: mix-blend-mode and isolation on SVG elements; the web, macOS and Linux blend, iOS declares it unsupported.
@ref LLP 1066: CSS `background-image` — `none`, or one linear-gradient()/radial-gradient(). Painted over background-color, clipped as the background is.
@ref LLP 1063: an `animation` the node plays as it leaves; the outermost removed node stays as a ghost until it ends, so every one must end. Grammar: `_animations`.
@ref LLP 1063: how the node's laid-out origin in its parent moves when layout moves it; the last declaration naming no property governs. Grammar: `_transitions`.

@ref LLP 1061 D1: the uniform scale a node shows while a pointer holds it pressed, about `transform-origin`; 1 is none. Not CSS: the host owns the feedback (no runner round trip), eased in 120 ms, and keeps it under reduced motion. It composes with, never replaces, the `scale` row.
@ref LLP 1069.001 D6: CSS `accent-color`, the tint of a form control (a checkbox's fill, a switch's on track); auto is the platform's.
@ref LLP 1069.001 D6: CSS `appearance`; auto draws the platform's control, none hands the look to the author's box. Not inherited, as in CSS.

@ref LLP 1057.003 D1: `none | <dashed-ident> [x | y]?`, a timeline the node's presented translate drives (a drag's held value, then its release spring); CSS scroll-timeline's shape with a drag as its source, a deviation LLP 1001 declares.

@ref LLP 1057.003 D1: CSS `animation-timeline`, `auto | <dashed-ident>`: the node's animations are held at the named drag timeline's progress, never played on the clock. @ref LLP 1055.002 D2: a third value, `clock(<ident>)`, keeps them on the clock from a start every animation on that clock timeline shares, a deviation LLP 1001 declares.
@ref LLP 1057.003 D1: CSS `animation-range`, `normal | <length> <length>`: where on the timeline the animations run 0% to 100%.

@ref LLP 1057.003 D4: CSS `timeline-scope`, `none | all | <dashed-ident>#`: names a timeline declared below the node (its single declaring descendant, else an inactive timeline) in scope for the node's subtree. Not inherited, as in CSS.
@ref LLP 1077 D3: CSS `text-shadow`, `none` or one shadow (no list, no spread), under the glyphs and decorations; a missing colour is currentcolor. Inherited, as in CSS.
@ref LLP 1077 D2: CSS `mask-image`, `none` or one gradient in background-image's grammar (LLP 1066), its alpha over the border box. Not inherited.

@ref LLP 1077 D1: CSS `corner-shape`, one to four of round | squircle | square | bevel | scoop | notch | superellipse(K), plus -apple-continuous (Apple's continuous curve on every host; declared in LLP 1001). Shapes the corners `border-radius` sizes.
@ref LLP 1077 D7: the Compat Standard's `-webkit-text-stroke-width`, a width in px centred on the glyphs' outlines and painted over their fill; 0 is none. Inherited, as in Compat.
@ref LLP 1077 D7: `-webkit-text-stroke-color`, initial currentcolor. Inherited.

@ref LLP 1077 D6: CSS `background-clip`: the background colour and image painted within the border box (initial), the padding box, the content box, or the glyphs of the node's own text. Not inherited.

@ref LLP 1077 D8: the axis of CSS `rotate` (`x`, `y`, `z` or three numbers), set with `rotate`'s angle by the one `rotate` attribute; initial z. The angle is `rotate` (bit 62), which the engine animates.
@ref LLP 1077 D8: CSS `translate`'s third length, px, set with x and y by the one `translate` attribute.
@ref LLP 1077 D8: CSS `perspective`, px; 0 is `none`. On the parent: it projects its children's 3D transforms.
@ref LLP 1077 D8: CSS `perspective-origin`, the vanishing point in the parent's box; initial 50% 50%.
@ref LLP 1077 D8: CSS `backface-visibility`: a hidden box turned away from the viewer paints nothing.
@ref LLP 1077 D10: not CSS. How an SF Symbol draws: monochrome (in `color`), hierarchical, palette (`symbol-palette`), or multicolor. Inherited, as SwiftUI's environment is; the web draws monochrome.
@ref LLP 1077 D10: not CSS. A symbol's palette, one to three colours, under `symbol-rendering: palette`. Inherited.
@ref LLP 1077 D11: not CSS. A variable symbol's value, 0 to 1 (Wi-Fi bars, volume); `none` (-1) draws it whole.

@ref LLP 1077 D12: not CSS. An SF Symbol effect: a continuing one (pulse, breathe, rotate, variable-color, scale) plays while set; a discrete one (bounce, wiggle) plays each time `symbolEffectValue` changes; replace plays when the source changes.
@ref LLP 1077 D14: not CSS. Host-owned feedback when a pointer presses the node, as `press-scale` is (no runner round trip): a selection tick or an impact.
@ref LLP 1077 D15: not CSS. How a text's digits change: numeric rolls each changed digit (up, or down for numeric-countdown).
@ref LLP 1077 D16: not CSS. A scroll container's edge effect where content meets a bar (iOS 26): automatic, soft, hard or none.
@ref LLP 1077 D17: not CSS. The iPad pointer's effect over the node: highlight, lift or hover; auto is the platform's.
@ref LLP 1077 D18: not CSS. Whether Smart Invert leaves the node's pixels alone: auto ignores images, video and canvases; ignore leaves any node's.

@ref LLP 1066 D7: CSS `background-attachment`. `fixed` sizes and places the gradient box on the viewport, not the node's padding box: one gradient across every node that has it, staying still as they scroll (a messenger's outgoing bubbles). `local` is not admitted.
CSS cursor (inherited), every keyword but image cursors: the web writes it, Windows (LLP 1015.000) and macOS map it to a system cursor.

CSS `order` (feed F19): a flex or grid item's place in its container's order-modified document order, which the kernel gives the layout engine as its child order. Painting and focus stay in document order; LLP 1001 declares the paint half.

CSS `text-indent` as a length in points (the reader diary): the first line of a paragraph starts this far in from its start edge, and has that much less room; negative hangs it out. A percentage and the `hanging`/`each-line` keywords are refused by the compiler.

_transitions: The `transition` row is CSS `transition` (LLP 1002): count u8 (≤8), then per declaration property u8 (0 all, then 1 + `Property`: 1 translate, 2 scale, 3 rotate, 4 opacity, 5 height, 6 stroke-dashoffset, 7 r, 8 color, 9 background-color, 10 fill, 11 stroke, 12 cx, 13 cy, 14 x, 15 y, 16 rx, 17 ry, 18 border-top-color, 19 border-right-color, 20 border-bottom-color, 21 border-left-color, 22 tint-color, 23 box-shadow — LLP 1062; 24, box-shadow's colour alone, is refused; 25 is CSS's `border-color` shorthand), duration f32 s, delay f32 s, easing u8 (0 linear, 1 ease, 2 ease-in, 3 ease-out, 4 ease-in-out, 5 cubic-bezier + 4×f32, 6 steps + u16 count + u8 position, 7 spring + f32 stiffness/damping/mass, 8 linear() + u8 count + count×(f32 input, f32 output)). Its Rust type lives in exact-motion; the kernel owns the bytes.
_animations: The `animation` row is CSS `animation` (LLP 1055 D5): count u8 (≤8), then per animation name (str), duration f32 s, delay f32 s, easing (as `_transitions`, never a spring), iteration count f32 (+inf is `infinite`), direction u8 (0 normal, 1 reverse, 2 alternate, 3 alternate-reverse), fill u8 (0 none, 1 forwards, 2 backwards, 3 both), paused u8, then its keyframes: count u8 (≤32), per keyframe offset f32 in [0,1], easing flag u8 (0 the animation's, 1 followed by an easing), count u8, per value property u8 (as `Property`), then its components as f32: one, two for `translate`, three for `box-shadow` (offset x, y and blur, in points; its colour is the next value, `box-shadow`'s colour half), four for a colour (premultiplied sRGB red, green, blue, alpha; LLP 1055.000 D6), a colour then u8 1 and four more for the dark half of a `light-dark()` pair, else u8 0 (LLP 1062 D9). Its Rust type lives in exact-motion; the kernel owns the bytes.
_opcodes: The closed wire-visible op list for EXWF frame revision 1. There is no op count on the wire; consumers iterate by validated lengths.
_symbols: [role, Apple system symbol name, browser SVG path in a 24-unit box]. The path is stroked; a filled state is its own role, `<role>-fill` for Apple's `<name>.fill`, whose path is a filled silhouette (even-odd, so a cutout is a subpath). Portable roles only; symbol:sf/<name> passes an opaque name directly to Apple (LLP 1035.004.000), without a table entry. The sf namespace is reserved.
_materials: [name, iOS UIBlurEffect.Style (or glass / glassClear: UIGlassEffect), macOS NSVisualEffectView.Material (or glass / glassClear: NSGlassEffectView), web and Linux blur px, web saturate %, light tint, dark tint]. @ref LLP 1053.000 D4: `backgroundMaterial`'s whole vocabulary, one row per platform material, kebab-case one-to-one. A `~` marks a platform without that material: it draws the one named instead and logs so once. The web and Linux columns are stated approximations of Apple's look, not parity. Hosts never admit a platform name directly.
_buttonStyles: [name, iOS 26+ UIButton.Configuration factory, the factory before iOS 26, macOS NSButton look (borderless, push, push-accent: the accent as bezelColor, glass: NSBezelStyleGlass on macOS 26 else push, glass-accent), web and Linux look (ua: the browser's own button, text, soft, fill, glass, glass-fill)]. @ref LLP 1069.011 D2: `buttonStyle`'s whole vocabulary, kebab-case one-to-one with Apple's names. A `~` marks a platform drawing a stand-in, silently; the agent reports the requested and the drawn style. Hosts never admit a platform name directly.
